description: Build the audit log viewer page at /admin/audit with GET API route, paginated DataTable, action-type and date-range filters, and a 'Run Cleanup' button that calls the cleanup endpoint from FEAT-F03. Also adds the Audit Log nav item to AdminLayout. Depends on FEAT-F03 (cleanup endpoint must exist). Independent of FEAT-F02 in terms of data, but the sidebar nav item for Signers was added in FEAT-F02 — this FEAT adds the Audit Log nav item.
steps: Create src/app/api/admin/audit/route.ts. GET handler only. Authenticate with `requireAdmin()`. Accept query params: `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 50, max 100), `action` (optional string, exact match), `actorId` (optional), `dateFrom` (optional ISO date string), `dateTo` (optional ISO date string). Always add a hard cutoff: `createdAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) }`. Merge any user-provided dateFrom/dateTo as additional constraints (intersection, not union). Query `db.auditEvent.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page-1)*limit, take: limit, select: { id: true, action: true, entityType: true, entityId: true, createdAt: true, meta: true, actor: { select: { id: true, email: true, name: true } } } })`. Also run `db.auditEvent.count({ where })`. Return `apiSuccess({ data, total, page, limit })`.

Create src/app/admin/audit/page.tsx as a server component. Export `metadata = { title: 'Audit Log — WSS QR Signature' }`. Use `export const instant = false`. Render `<PageHeader title='Audit Log' subtitle='Last 60 days of admin activity' />` and `<AuditLogClient />` (no props needed — client fetches its own data).

Create src/app/admin/audit/AuditLogClient.tsx as a 'use client' component. State: page (default 1), action filter (default ''), dateFrom (default ''), dateTo (default ''). On mount and filter change, fetch `GET /api/admin/audit?page=...&limit=50&action=...&dateFrom=...&dateTo=...`. Render: (1) Filter bar at the top: an `<Input type='text' label='Filter by action' />` for action (e.g. 'LOGIN', 'SIGNER_CREATED'), `<Input type='date' label='From' />`, `<Input type='date' label='To' />`, and a 'Reset' `<Button variant='secondary'>` that clears all filters. (2) A `<DataTable>` with columns: Timestamp (formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', { day:'2-digit', month:'short', year:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })`), Actor (actor.name ?? actor.email ?? 'System'), Action (monospace span with the raw action string), Entity (entityType + ' ' + entityId truncated to 20 chars), Details (meta parsed from JSON string and rendered as a compact key=value line, first 2 keys only, with ellipsis if more). (3) A 'Run Cleanup' `<Button variant='secondary' size='sm'>` aligned right above the table. On click: POST /api/admin/audit/cleanup, show toast with deleted count on success. This button triggers the 60-day retention cleanup manually. (4) Pagination handled by DataTable `onPageChange`. (5) Use existing DataTable, Button, Input, Toast, PageHeader components. All inputs must have labels.

Update src/components/layout/AdminLayout.tsx: import `History` from 'lucide-react' (it may already be imported from FEAT-F02 if Users was added). Add `{ href: '/admin/audit', label: 'Audit Log', icon: History, exact: false }` to NAV_ITEMS after the Signers item and before Settings. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`.
Final: run `npm run test` to ensure existing tests still pass. Run `npm run lint` and fix any new lint errors.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/admin/audit returns paginated audit events filtered to last 60 days
/admin/audit page renders audit log table with timestamp, actor, action, entity columns
Action filter and date range filter work correctly
'Run Cleanup' button calls POST /api/admin/audit/cleanup and shows success toast
Sidebar shows 'Audit Log' nav item with History icon
